title: Prometeo · continuidad y orquestación entre chats
mission: Build Prometeo as a portable multi-root cognitive operating system that survives chat/model loss, preserves governing method and memory, continuously compiles useful work, lets identical fresh workers self-assign safe opportunities through atomic claims, converges evidence/results through explicit authority, and minimizes human coordination to durable goals plus real boundaries.
human_goal: The human can normally send only `.` to a bound parent. Fresh worker chats eventually receive one identical `/w` bootstrap and choose distinct READY work themselves. The human does not remember plans, choose unique worker codes, track launches, carry context, copy returns or design each next batch. Prometeo, Facultad, Alumnos and future roots can progress in parallel over one durable control substrate.
success_conditions: Fresh parent reincarnation works without transcript and starts from global Continuity Head.
Bound `.` performs useful work from durable state without asking the human to reconstruct the plan.
Active Method + Product Memory + Campaign state govern successors, not merely stored files.
Planner/Compiler continuously turns goals/returns/incidents/proposals into dependency-aware opportunities.
Multiple identical fresh workers can atomically claim distinct work without duplicate substantive execution.
Workers have durable claim/STARTED/RETURN/DONE evidence, stale/retry/supersession handling and safe post-return continuation.
Parallel results converge through Steward/Merger with Current/Human Accepted/Served separation.
Facultad and Alumnos become recoverable durable project roots, not memories tied to old chats.
At least two autonomous worker generations complete without the human redesigning prompts or transporting results.
Parent conversation can disappear mid-campaign and a fresh successor continues from durable state.
Live remains an optional passive ambient projection of the same durable control state.
non_goals: Treating Live/UI as the current core problem.
Maximizing number of occupied chats regardless of useful information/progress.
Literally cloning parent transcripts into many chats.
Making worker completion equivalent to product authority.
current_frontier: Finish/converge B-BIGPIC-01 without idling on lagging scouts, compile Architecture/Active Method vNext, then implement the autonomous swarm kernel in PLAN-AUTOSWARM-01 while binding Facultad and Alumnos durable roots in parallel.
next_human_action: None now. On this bound parent, `.` is sufficient. After generic `/w` passes collision/recovery canaries, the only normal worker-launch action should be opening any number of fresh chats and pasting the same `/w` bootstrap.
update_law: Material changes to goals, method, architecture, memory, campaign state, invariants, negative knowledge, project roots, opportunities/claims, delegated work, integration or frontier must update durable state before relying on transcript memory.
authority_law: This object orchestrates and remembers; Current/Catalog/Lineage/Human Accepted/Served remain distinct authorities. Worker proposals/returns remain candidates until integrated through the correct owner/steward.
